description: This file contains utility functions for gradient clipping in PyTorch, including functions to compute total gradient norm, clip gradients by norm or value, and deprecated gradient clipping functions. It is part of the torch.nn.utils module.

methods.name: _no_grad
methods.description: Decorator to wrap functions so they run without tracking gradients, avoiding circular imports.

methods.name: _get_total_norm
methods.description: Computes the total norm of a set of tensors, with support for different norm types and foreach API.

methods.name: _clip_grads_with_norm_
methods.description: Scales gradients of parameters in-place based on a pre-calculated total norm and max norm.

methods.name: clip_grad_norm_
methods.description: Clips the gradient norm of parameters in-place to a maximum norm, modifying gradients directly.

methods.name: clip_grad_norm
methods.description: Deprecated wrapper for clip_grad_norm_ with warning message.

methods.name: clip_grad_value_
methods.description: Clips gradients of parameters in-place to a specified maximum absolute value.
